result.topic_en: The page holds scratch calculations with Gaussian integers related to the modulus 9+14i. They include multiples and reductions of complex numbers, sequences of +/− signs that look like quadratic or biquadratic character determinations, and small dot-and-sign lattice diagrams.

methods.what: Writing a quotient of a Gaussian integer by the modulus 9+14i in coordinates, which leads to a linear condition on X and Y
Tabulating multiples of small Gaussian integers, reduced with respect to a complex modulus, each marked with a sign (+/−) as a residue-character evaluation
Successive reduction of complex quotients with associated signs, apparently counting sign changes to determine a character
Lattice-point diagrams marking residue classes with symbols + − × o
methods.quote: [diagram: grid of dots with signs + − × o]
